about: The name a scene's file is known by (docs/we-format.md, row 4): Wallpaper Engine is a Windows program, where names differ neither by case nor by the slash, nor here by whether a letter's marks are written with it or apart. The app lays the table out under such names (WallpaperEngineScene.key); the player looks names up the same way (key in values.js), names that scripts give while playing among them.
